product_overview: FlashPoint is a mobile-first web platform to create, discover and manage Trading Card Game (TCG) tournaments and leagues with real-time updates and player/organizer dashboards.
core_goals: Allow organizers to create and manage tournaments (Swiss / Single Elimination) including rounds and pairings.
Enable players to discover tournaments, join events, and report match results (local reporting and organizer confirmation).
Provide unified dashboards for players and organizers (NewArea / MyArea) with real-time updates via Firebase.
Support fast entry flows (QR codes) and global rankings for league and tournament standings.
Enforce secure access to private areas through Firebase Auth and protected routes.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Login with email and password via Firebase Auth and protect routes that require authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input -> Fill password input -> Click Login button -> See /new-area
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input -> Fill password input with incorrect credentials -> Click Login button -> See authentication error message

features.name: Tournament Creation & Management
features.description: Organizers create tournaments, configure type (Swiss/Single Elimination), add rounds and manage tournament settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /tournament/create -> Fill tournament details (name, game, type) -> Submit creation form -> See /tournament/:id dashboard
Navigate to /tournament/create -> Fill tournament details missing required field -> Submit creation form -> See validation error message
Navigate to /tournament/:id -> Click Add rounds to tournament -> Fill round settings -> Submit round creation -> See new round listed in dashboard
Navigate to /tournament/:id -> Click Add rounds to tournament with invalid configuration -> Submit round creation -> See round configuration error message

features.name: Tournament Pairing and Round Advancement
features.description: Advance rounds and generate pairings using Swiss or Single Elimination algorithms; handle insufficient players or pairing conflicts.
user_flows: Navigate to /tournament/:id -> Click Advance Round -> See pairings generated for new round -> See updated round in list
Navigate to /tournament/:id -> Click Advance Round with insufficient registered players -> See error message preventing advancement
Navigate to /tournament/:id -> Click Advance Round when pairings already exist -> See conflict/warning message

features.name: Player Participation (Join Tournament)
features.description: Players discover public tournaments and join via 'Participar' button or QR code; joining requires authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to /discover -> Click "Participar" button on a tournament card -> See join confirmation modal -> See user listed as participant on /tournament/:id
Navigate to /discover -> Click "Participar" button while not authenticated -> Redirect to /login -> See login prompt
Navigate to /discover -> Click Scan QR code -> Scan valid QR code -> See join confirmation -> See /tournament/:id

features.name: Match Result Reporting (Player and Organizer)
features.description: Players can report local match results from their dashboard ('Minha Mesa'); organizers can report and confirm results on the tournament dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /new-area -> Locate "Minha Mesa" -> Report match results -> See confirmation and updated standings in dashboard
Navigate to /new-area -> Locate "Minha Mesa" -> Attempt to report invalid scores -> See validation error message
Navigate to /tournament/:id -> Open a match in round -> Report match results as organizer -> See updated bracket/standings
Navigate to /tournament/:id -> Attempt to report result for a finalized match -> See conflict/error notice

features.name: Discovery & Filters
features.description: Browse public tournaments and leagues, filter by status (Active/Concluded), game and other attributes to find events to join.
user_flows: Navigate to /discover -> Use filters to select Active tournaments -> See filtered list of tournaments
Navigate to /discover -> Apply filters that match no tournaments -> See empty state message

features.name: Unified Dashboard (NewArea / MyArea)
features.description: Provide a unified dashboard for players and organizers to view participations, organized events, and quick actions including access to "Minha Mesa".
user_flows: Navigate to /new-area -> See unified dashboard with organized events and participations -> Click a tournament card -> Navigate to /tournament/:id
Navigate to /my-area -> See list of user matches and tournaments -> Click a match -> Navigate to match details
Navigate to /new-area while not authenticated -> Redirect to /login -> See login prompt

features.name: Rankings & Leaderboards
features.description: Display global rankings and league-accumulated standings with filtering by game and league.
user_flows: Navigate to /ranking -> See global rankings list -> Use filter to change game -> See updated ranking list
Navigate to /ranking -> Trigger network failure -> See error/try again message

features.name: QR Code Entry
features.description: Allow fast entry to join a tournament by scanning a QR code that links to the tournament's join flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /discover -> Click Scan QR code -> Scan valid QR code -> See join confirmation and navigate to /tournament/:id
Navigate to /discover -> Click Scan QR code -> Scan invalid or expired QR code -> See invalid code error message
